cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 2.8.3)
project(slic)
include(ExternalProject)

## Find catkin macros and libraries
## if COMPONENTS list like find_package(catkin REQUIRED COMPONENTS xyz)
## is used, also find other catkin packages
# execute_process(COMMAND
#   git config --global http.sslVerify false)
## System dependencies are found with CMake's conventions
# find_package(Boost REQUIRED COMPONENTS system)
# the archive of github.com/garaemon/SLIC-Superpixels at the commit, kept in jsk-ros-pkg/archives, as the archive
# generated by GitHub at each request sometimes fails
set(SLIC_URL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsk-ros-pkg/archives/master/SLIC-Superpixels-78d9a2ba7ae1d3fee8c2ec774a52536c5f08f07c.zip)
# ExternalProject tries the URLs in turn (CMake 3.7 and later): the same URL again, and the archive of
# GitHub, for a transient error of the network (e.g. of the CI)
if(NOT CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.7)
  set(SLIC_URL ${SLIC_URL} ${SLIC_URL} https://github.com/garaemon/SLIC-Superpixels/archive/78d9a2ba7ae1d3fee8c2ec774a52536c5f08f07c.zip)
endif()
# with JSK_3RDPARTY_DOWNLOAD_DIR (e.g. a cache of the CI), the file is downloaded there, and is not
# downloaded again while its hash matches
if(NOT "$ENV{JSK_3RDPARTY_DOWNLOAD_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
  set(SLIC_DOWNLOAD_DIR DOWNLOAD_DIR $ENV{JSK_3RDPARTY_DOWNLOAD_DIR})
endif()
ExternalProject_Add(
  slic
  URL ${SLIC_URL}
  ${SLIC_DOWNLOAD_DIR}
  URL_HASH MD5=6555bf6fdc7c1651e3070ff1e2b884f3
  GIT_TAG 78d9a2ba7ae1d3fee8c2ec774a52536c5f08f07c
  CMAKE_COMMAND echo "configure"
  BUILD_COMMAND echo "build"
  INSTALL_COMMAND echo "install"
  )

find_package( OpenCV REQUIRED )
install(CODE "execute_process(COMMAND cmake -E make_directory ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/include/)")
install(CODE "execute_process(COMMAND cmake -E copy slic.h ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/include/ WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/slic-prefix/src/slic/)")

install(CODE "execute_process(COMMAND cmake -E make_directory ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib/)")
install(CODE "execute_process(COMMAND gcc -I${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS} -fPIC --shared -o ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib/libslic.so ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/slic-prefix/src/slic/slic.cpp)")
